description: Land Title Settlement Department - Koholankala, Hambanthota  D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Cad. Map No. 830109
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, ownership details (all listed as "The State"), and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes classification.
